scope: v1.2.4 host-first Q8.7 fixed-point freight over the MEGA65 math unit

representation.storage: ordinary signed 15-bit fixnum; no new tag or boxed type
representation.constructor_fraction: the optional second fx argument is an exact signed count of 1/128 units, not a decimal literal

public_surface.fx->string: (fx->string value), exact finite decimal with at least one fractional digit

arithmetic.addition_and_subtraction: exact or existing arithmetic error before an out-of-domain raw result is produced
arithmetic.multiply: unsigned magnitudes are multiplied as 32-bit operands; divide the 64-bit product by 128 and round the discarded seven bits
arithmetic.divide: the unsigned magnitude of the dividend is shifted left seven bits before hardware division; quotient fraction bits decide rounding
arithmetic.overflow: existing arithmetic error path; no saturation, wraparound, native status or new resident string

math_unit.access: existing strict-byte peek/poke primitives; no new native seam
math_unit.transaction_rule: compute every input byte before the first poke; from that poke through the last result peek, execute only poke, peek, bit tests and control flow, because ordinary Lisp multiply/divide share the same unit
math_unit.concurrency: the synchronous top-level compiled VM owns one transaction; no callback, nested evaluator, IRQ math consumer or scheduler hook may enter it
math_unit.target_claim: documented layout only until the Phase-M probe confirms high product bytes and the division fraction-bit row

placement.legacy_stdlib_fixed: superseded; it is neither extended nor included

execution_lanes: source-compiled P0 VM with modeled math registers
emitted-artifact P0 VM with modeled math registers
required_edges: positive overflow at the asymmetric edge
proof.execution_witness: math input writes and refreshes must be positive in every arithmetic lane
mutation_families: arithmetic inserted inside the math-unit transaction

claim_limit: Host semantics, host-modeled register transport and one non-promotable WPLTO capacity card only. No on-metal fx or fraction-layout claim before Phase M.
